name: Who is responsible for preparing and completing a construction punch list?

mainEntity.name: Who is responsible for preparing and completing a construction punch list?

acceptedAnswer.text: The responsibility for preparing a punch list is usually shared, with the client, architect, or project manager identifying items, and the general contractor compiling the formal list. The general contractor is then responsible for overseeing the completion of all items on the punch list. At Frasheski Construction, our project manager collaborates closely with you during the final walk-through to document every detail, then our team meticulously addresses each item to ensure your complete satisfaction with the finished project.
acceptedAnswer.description: The client, architect, or project manager identifies items, the general contractor compiles the list, and the general contractor is responsible for completing all punch list items.
